text: 上半年上海外贸整体运行稳步向好，进出口2.55万亿元，同比增长18.6%。其中出口1.14万亿元，增长20.1%，首次突破万亿元大关；进口1.41万亿元，增长17.4%，外贸规模创历史新高。（央视新闻）
text_en: Shanghai's foreign trade performed steadily in the first half of the year, with imports and exports totaling 2.55 trillion yuan, up 18.6% year-on-year. Exports reached 1.14 trillion yuan, up 20.1%, surpassing 1 trillion yuan for the first time; imports were 1.41 trillion yuan, up 17.4%, with the trade scale hitting a record high. (CCTV News)
